text: DSH Git Memory 是一个面向 DSH 的上下文与会话状态插件，当前版本处于兼容性验证阶段。它向系统提示注入状态说明，监听会话事件并在进程内累计事件总数、回合结束数和最近事件时间。用户可以通过 /memory status 查看集成状态，也可让模型调用只读的 memory_status 工具获取结构化快照。它适合检查插件是否接入以及观察会话事件计数；当前实现不提供长期记忆写入或搜索。安装说明面向 DSH Web profile。

DSH Git Memory is a DSH status plugin in a compatibility-spike phase. It adds a prompt note, counts session events and turn endings, and tracks the latest event time. Users can run /memory status or call memory_status for a read-only snapshot. Long-term memory storage and search are not implemented.

给系统提示加一段当前记忆功能的状态说明。

I want a command that reports session event counts and status.

DSH Git Memory 的功能「会话事件计数」：插件监听 session/event，在进程内累计观察到的事件数、turn/end 数量以及最近事件时间；这些数据可通过状态输出读取。
DSH Git Memory 的功能「斜杠状态命令」：用户运行 /memory status 可查看版本、阶段、上下文模式、事件计数、启动时间和最近事件时间；/memory help 展示可用子命令。
DSH Git Memory 的功能「模型状态工具」：模型可调用只读 memory_status 工具，获得包含事件计数和时间字段的结构化运行快照。
DSH Git Memory 的功能「动态上下文提示」：插件启动时向系统提示注册一段状态文本，说明当前处于兼容性验证模式，并提供状态工具名称。

Git-backed, reviewable long-term context for DeepSeek Harness.

> Status: compatibility spike / pre-alpha. The current release proves the DSH
> integration seams and deliberately does **not** store user memory yet.

@starfishwrx/dsh-git-memory README · Product direction：DSH Git Memory is being built around one trust invariant:

> One controlled memory transaction equals one Git commit.

The intended product gives DeepSeek Harness useful context on day one, then
accumulates source-backed memory during normal use. Accepted memory stays local,
diffable, reviewable, and revertible.

@starfishwrx/dsh-git-memory README · What works today：- Installable DSH bundle with a `dsh.bundle` manifest.
- Stable dynamic context registered through `ctx.systemPrompt.context()`.
- Metadata-only observation of `session/event`.
- A direct human command: `/memory status`.
- A read-only model tool: `memory_status`.
- Windows and Ubuntu CI.
- No transcript persistence, no background model calls, and no memory writes.

The spike records only aggregate event counts and timestamps in process memory.
It never retains message or tool-result content.

@starfishwrx/dsh-git-memory README · Quick start from source：Prerequisites:

- Node.js 24 or newer.
- pnpm 11.
- DeepSeek Harness `0.1.0-rc.6`.

```bash
git clone https://github.com/starfishwrx/dsh-git-memory.git
cd dsh-git-memory
pnpm install
pnpm verify

Start the Web profile, then run:

```text
/memory status
```

The model can also call:

```text
memory_status
```

@starfishwrx/dsh-git-memory README · Planned user experience：1. `/memory setup` gathers basic profile, project, goal, preference, boundary,
   and consent information.
2. A confirmed onboarding draft becomes an auditable baseline commit.
3. Normal DSH sessions generate bounded, redacted memory candidates.
4. Review mode lets the user approve, edit, or reject candidates.
5. Conservative automation can be enabled only after an initial trust period.
6. DSH receives a bounded dynamic context snapshot; detailed recall uses
   `memory_search`.

@starfishwrx/dsh-git-memory README · Planned user experience：See [the roadmap](docs/ROADMAP.md) and
[architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) for the delivery plan.

@starfishwrx/dsh-git-memory README · Safety posture：- Managed repositories will live under `$DSH_HOME/git-memory`, not inside a
  user's source repository.
- Memory tools will not accept arbitrary filesystem destinations.
- Sensitive values such as credentials, private keys, cookies, and tokens are
  hard-denied.
- Raw session transcripts are not copied into the memory Git history.
- Git remotes, pushing, and writes outside managed repositories are disabled by
  default.
- Model-inferred observations can never silently become global user policy.

@starfishwrx/dsh-git-memory README · Safety posture：Read [PRIVACY.md](PRIVACY.md), [THREAT_MODEL.md](THREAT_MODEL.md), and

pnpm install
pnpm typecheck
pnpm test
pnpm build

`pnpm verify` runs the stable CI checks. Maintainers with DSH installed can
set `DSH_BIN` to the absolute path of DSH's `lib/bin.js` and run
`pnpm smoke:dsh`. The smoke script installs the built bundle into a disposable
profile, boots DSH on an ephemeral port, checks the Web response, and cleans up.
